fusions.name: Termite Fishing
fusions.desc: A probing jab with the haft that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at its full reach of 5 tiles. Its damage rises 10% for each affliction on the target, up to 30%.

fusions.name: Long-Armed Swat
fusions.desc: Swings the haft round you at the full stretch of your arms, dealing 14 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and knocking each back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Knuckle Vault
fusions.desc: Plants the haft and swings you 4 tiles forward. Your movement speed rises 20% for 3 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Grips Back
fusions.desc: Each time you spend stamina, you deal 25% more physical damage for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds. Enemies you strike move 15% slower for 2 seconds.
